question_text: Explain why a visiting engineer might use a remote-access VPN to view internal maintenance records over hotel Wi-Fi.
adaptation_rationale: VPN purpose/countermeasure explicit; avoid source anonymity/speed generalizations. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
solution: It establishes an authenticated encrypted tunnel to the organization, protecting records on the untrusted local network and allowing authorized access to private internal services.

marking_points.criterion: Links encryption to confidentiality on hotel Wi-Fi or tunnel to private-resource access.
